summary: WEBZ is a commercial Urban Adult Contemporary radio station licensed to Mexico Beach, Florida, within the Panama City metro area. It is owned by iHeartMedia and broadcasts at 99.3 MHz. The station airs its Urban Adult Contemporary format under the brand name "99-3 The Beat".
